problems: The two lever knobs stand right in front of the round dial and cover its lower half, so the dial no longer reads as a perfect circle and the panel looks cluttered. Fix: raise the dial and screen (centre z 0.64 -> 0.71) and shorten the levers (0.2 -> 0.14) so the knobs stay below the dial bezel.

The panel is meant to be grey, but #d3d7dd renders almost pure white under the satin light, so the card would read as a white panel. I darkened it to #b4bac3 so it reads as light grey. Everything else checks out: the panel is sunk into the wall, the ledge sits on a base that stands on the floor, there are 5 red buttons, 2 levers on axles in their housings, a round dial and a square green screen with a wave line, and the framing is on the main body.
